fact: After the September 2025 MoU, the Libyan Authority for Grain Production and the Agronomic Research Center of Misrata trained on GMES crop-monitoring services (MISBAR, GUETCROP, SAQIYA) on their own plots and plan to adopt them for larger areas.
title: Implementation of the Partnership Agreement between OSS and the Libyan Authority for Grain Production: GMES North Africa services supporting the monitoring of agricultural campaigns
